# Update the CSV RSVP column based on latest text message replies

# Ensure required globals exist
assert 'file_resp' in globals(), 'CSV file not loaded'
assert 'all_latest' in globals(), 'Latest messages not loaded'

csv_text = file_resp['content']
lines = [ln for ln in csv_text.splitlines() if ln.strip()!='']
header_line = lines[0]
rows_lines = lines[1:]

# Parse rows into list preserving order
parsed_rows = []
for ln in rows_lines:
    parts = ln.split(',', 2)
    name = parts[0].strip()
    invited = parts[1].strip() if len(parts)>1 else ''
    rsvp = parts[2].strip() if len(parts)>2 else ''
    parsed_rows.append({'Name': name, 'Invited': invited, 'RSVP': rsvp, 'orig_line': ln})

print('CSV header:', header_line)
print('Parsed row names:', [r['Name'] for r in parsed_rows])

# Decide RSVP from message text

def decide_rsvp(msg: str):
    s = msg.lower()
    yes_phrases = [
        "i'll be there",
        "ill be there",
        "i'll be at the reunion",
        "ill be at the reunion",
        "looking forward to the reunion",
        "yes, i'll be there",
        "yes, ill be there",
        "i am going",
        "i am there",
        "i'll be at the reunion"
    ]
    no_phrases = [
        "cannot make it",
        "can't join",
        "can't join",
        "sorry, can't join",
        "sorry, cant join",
        "can't join",
        "other plans",
        "cannot make it to reunion",
        "cannot make it to reunion this time",
        "cannot make it to reunion this time",
        "i am sorry, i cannot make it",
        "i am sorry, i cannot make it",
        "i am sorry, i cannot make it to reunion",
        "i am sorry, i cannot make it to reunion this time",
        "i am sorry",
        "i cannot make it",
        "cant join"
    ]

    # Strong yes first
    if any(p in s for p in yes_phrases):
        return 'yes'
    # Strong no
    if any(p in s for p in no_phrases):
        # But avoid misclassifying message that includes 'other plans' with cancellation and then says attending.
        # If message contains both cancellation + attending phrase, keep yes.
        if ("plans got cancelled" in s or "my plans got cancelled" in s) and ("i'll be" in s or "ill be" in s or "i am there" in s):
